result.instructions: Tools for Tatango, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which of our subscriber lists has the most phone numbers, and how many have unsubscribed?"; "Show the messages we sent to the VIP list in the last 30 days."; "Add 2141234567 to the Spring Sale list with the first name Jane.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Tatango data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run tatango_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run tatango_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run tatango_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. tatango_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: tatango_get_account
tools.title: Get account
tools.description: Show the Tatango account that the API key belongs to (id, login email, username). Good first call to confirm the connection. GET /api/v2/accounts/me.

tools.name: tatango_list_lists
tools.title: List lists
tools.description: List the subscriber lists of the account (name, id, subscriber counts). Use the list id in the other tools. GET /api/v2/lists.

include_deleted.description: Include deleted lists (the API default is true).

tools.name: tatango_get_list
tools.title: Get list
tools.description: Show one subscriber list by id, including its keywords and opt-in settings. GET /api/v2/lists/{ID}.

list_id.description: Numeric id of the list (from tatango_list_lists).

tools.name: tatango_list_subscribers
tools.title: List subscribers
tools.description: List the subscribed phone numbers of one list. Opted-out numbers are in tatango_list_unsubscribed. GET /api/v2/lists/{ID}/subscribers.

list_id.description: Numeric id of the list (from tatango_list_lists).

tools.name: tatango_list_unsubscribed
tools.title: List unsubscribed numbers
tools.description: List the phone numbers that unsubscribed from one list. Do not message these numbers. GET /api/v2/lists/{ID}/subscribers/unsubscribed.

list_id.description: Numeric id of the list (from tatango_list_lists).

tools.name: tatango_get_subscriber
tools.title: Get subscriber
tools.description: Show one subscriber of a list: phone number, name, custom fields and tags. GET /api/v2/lists/{ID}/subscribers/{SUBSCRIBER_ID}.

list_id.description: Numeric id of the list (from tatango_list_lists).

tools.name: tatango_list_custom_fields
tools.title: List custom fields
tools.description: List the custom subscriber fields defined for one list. GET /api/v2/lists/{ID}/custom_fields.

list_id.description: Numeric id of the list (from tatango_list_lists).

tools.name: tatango_list_webhooks
tools.title: List webhooks
tools.description: List the webhooks that send events for one list (delivery status, replies). GET /api/v2/lists/{ID}/webhooks.

list_id.description: Numeric id of the list (from tatango_list_lists).

tools.name: tatango_list_sent_messages
tools.title: List sent messages
tools.description: List the messages already sent to one list, optionally within a UTC date range. GET /api/v2/lists/{ID}/messages.

list_id.description: Numeric id of the list (from tatango_list_lists).

start_date.description: Only messages sent on or after this UTC date, YYYYMMDD.

end_date.description: Only messages sent on or before this UTC date, YYYYMMDD.

tools.name: tatango_list_scheduled_messages
tools.title: List scheduled messages
tools.description: List the messages scheduled but not yet sent to one list, optionally within a UTC date range. GET /api/v2/lists/{ID}/messages/scheduled.

list_id.description: Numeric id of the list (from tatango_list_lists).

start_date.description: Only messages sent on or after this UTC date, YYYYMMDD.

end_date.description: Only messages sent on or before this UTC date, YYYYMMDD.

tools.name: tatango_get_message
tools.title: Get message
tools.description: Show one sent message of a list: content, send time and delivery counts. GET /api/v2/lists/{ID}/messages/{MESSAGE_ID}.

list_id.description: Numeric id of the list (from tatango_list_lists).

tools.name: tatango_add_subscriber
tools.title: Add subscriber
tools.description: Add a phone number to one list, with optional name, email, birthdate (YYYYMMDD) and zip code. Changes the list. POST /api/v2/lists/{ID}/subscribers.

list_id.description: Numeric id of the list (from tatango_list_lists).

phone_number.description: Phone number, digits only (no spaces, dashes or +).

tools.name: tatango_send_transactional_message
tools.title: Send transactional message
tools.description: Send ONE SMS or MMS to one phone number, for example an order or appointment notice. It sends a real text message to a real person. SMS is limited to 160 characters; MMS needs a subject. POST /api/v2/transactional_messages.

phone_number.description: Phone number, digits only (no spaces, dashes or +).

content.description: Message text. SMS: at most 160 characters.

is_mms.description: true sends an MMS (needs subject); false sends an SMS.

subject.description: MMS subject line. Required when is_mms is true.

fallback_content.description: Text-only fallback for handsets that cannot receive MMS (160 characters).

prompts.title: Get started with Tatango
prompts.description: What you can do with Tatango here, with example requests to try.
